query: SELECT DISTINCT a.activity_sequence,a.kind,a.message_id,a.root_id,a.topic_id,a.actor_key FROM board_activity a JOIN project_reader_state prs ON prs.reader_key=? AND prs.project_id=a.project_id LEFT JOIN topic_read_bookmarks tb ON tb.reader_key=prs.reader_key AND tb.topic_id=a.topic_id LEFT JOIN thread_watches w ON w.reader_key=prs.reader_key AND w.root_id=a.root_id LEFT JOIN thread_read_bookmarks rb ON rb.reader_key=prs.reader_key AND rb.root_id=a.root_id WHERE a.project_id=? AND a.activity_sequence>? AND a.activity_sequence<=? AND a.actor_key<>prs.reader_key AND ((a.kind='mainMessageCreated' AND prs.main_start IS NOT NULL AND a.activity_sequence>prs.main_start AND a.activity_sequence>COALESCE(tb.through_activity,0)) OR (a.kind<>'mainMessageCreated' AND w.active=1 AND a.activity_sequence>w.starts_after_activity AND a.activity_sequence>COALESCE(rb.through_activity,0))) ORDER BY a.activity_sequence ASC LIMIT ?
